commands.skyabyss_play.help.0: §bPlaytest commands (/skyabyss play) §7- permission 2. [targets] takes several players (@a, a party); default yourself. Targets go after the arguments (before optional ones)
commands.skyabyss_play.help.1: §e# Chapter/places §fplay chapter <0-5> [targets] [stage] §7- set up a chapter (0 fresh/1 whale/2 tide/3 storm/4 ember/5 abyss). Give targets to give a stage
commands.skyabyss_play.help.2: §fplay goto <place> [targets] §7- teleport (overworld, whale.., <titan>-<spot>, abyss, abyss-<mark>, abyss-depth-<n>)
commands.skyabyss_play.help.3: §fplay skip opening [targets] §7- skip the prologue  §fplay now [targets] §7- trigger the next event of the current objective
commands.skyabyss_play.help.4: §e# Boss/raid §fplay boss <whale|tide|storm|ember|raiju|smith|warden|nightmare> [targets] [tier 0-4] §7- go to the boss
commands.skyabyss_play.help.5: §fplay raid <titan> <room> [targets] §7- carry the party into a route room (1-3 / walk, wit, fight / room id); the main quest stage follows
commands.skyabyss_play.help.6: §fplay trials <titan> [targets] §7- clear every trial on that back
commands.skyabyss_play.help.7: §e# Quests §fplay quest list [targets] §7- active quests (main and sub)
commands.skyabyss_play.help.8: §fplay quest next [targets] [id] §7- advance to the next stage (no id = tracked, then the active main). Rewards, journal, strip and NPC topics update as for real
commands.skyabyss_play.help.9: §fplay quest set <id> <stage> [targets] §7, §fplay quest done <id> [targets] §7, §fplay quest reset <id> [targets]
commands.skyabyss_play.help.10: §e# Kit/state §fplay kit <iron|whale|tide|storm|ember> [targets] §7- gear set  §fplay status [targets] §7- chapter, quests, stilled titans
commands.skyabyss_play.help.11: §fplay heal|feed [targets] §7, §fplay god on|off [targets] §7, §fplay reset [targets] §7- heal, feed, invulnerable, back to a fresh state
commands.skyabyss_play.help.12: §fplay lore unlock-all|reset [targets] §7- unlock all lore / wipe it
commands.skyabyss_play.help.13: §e# World §fplay time day|noon|night|midnight §7, §fplay day <n> §7, §fplay fast on|off §7, §fplay weather clear|rain|thunder §7, §fplay peaceful on|off
commands.skyabyss_play.help.14: §7The old /skyabyss playtest ... still works for now (its commands are merged into play).
commands.skyabyss_play.help.15: §7Example: two players to the 2nd whale room -> /skyabyss play raid whale 2 @a  /  advance everyone's quest -> /skyabyss play quest next @a
commands.skyabyss_play.bad_stage: That stage is not in this quest: %s
commands.skyabyss_play.place_missing: That place is not built yet (skipped): %s
commands.skyabyss_play.raid_none: That titan has no raid rooms
commands.skyabyss_play.raid_bad_room: Cannot read the room: %s (1-3 / walk, wit, fight / room id)
commands.skyabyss_play.said.raid: Carrying to the %s raid room %s (%s players)
commands.skyabyss_play.help.16: §e■ Sealed boxes §fplay box give <kind> [n] §7— get boxes · §fplay box open §7— open the box opener screen here
